name: Sofa
definition: an upholstered seat with back and arms for two or more people.

name: Sectional sofa
definition: a sofa made of joined sections that can form a corner or L shape (corner sofa is an alias; configuration is an attribute).

name: Sofa bed
definition: a sofa sold as a seat that unfolds or pulls out into a bed with a hidden mattress (sleeper sofa).

name: Futon sofa
definition: a convertible frame whose seat cushion is the mattress, folding flat into a bed (the US "futon"), sold with or without its mattress.

name: Armchair
definition: an upholstered single seat with arms and back.

name: Hanging chair
definition: a single seat suspended from a ceiling or a stand.

name: Recliner
definition: an armchair whose back tilts and footrest rises, manually or by motor.

name: Rocking chair
definition: a chair on curved rockers or a glider base that rocks.

name: Chaise longue
definition: an upholstered indoor seat long enough to support the legs.

name: Sun lounger
definition: an outdoor reclining seat with an adjustable backrest, often on wheels, made to lie on in the sun.

name: Dining chair
definition: an upright chair with a back, made for a dining or side table.

name: Folding chair
definition: a chair that folds flat for storage or carrying.

name: High chair
definition: a raised chair with a tray or harness that holds a small child at table height.

name: Bar stool
definition: a tall seat without arms for a bar or counter.

name: Bench
definition: a long seat for several people, with or without a back (with storage is an attribute).

name: Ottoman
definition: a padded seat or footrest without back or arms (pouf; with storage is an attribute).

name: Office chair
definition: an adjustable seat made for desk work, usually swivelling on castors.

name: Bean bag chair
definition: a soft seat of a fabric bag filled with loose beads that takes the sitter's shape.

name: Floor chair
definition: a legless seat with a back that rests directly on the floor.

name: Platform bed
definition: a bed frame with a solid or slatted platform that takes a mattress without a separate base.

name: Bunk bed
definition: two or more beds stacked one above the other on one frame.

name: Daybed
definition: a bed sold as a bed that also serves as a seat, with a back and sides.

name: Four-poster bed
definition: a bed with a tall post at each corner, often carrying a canopy.

name: Baby cot (crib)
definition: a barred bed made for an infant or toddler.

name: Camp bed
definition: a light folding bed on a frame, used for camping or guests (US "cot").

name: Playpen (play yard)
definition: a freestanding enclosure that holds a small child in place to play or sleep.

name: Innerspring mattress
definition: a mattress whose support core is a unit of metal springs.

name: Foam mattress
definition: a mattress whose core is polyurethane, memory or other foam.

name: Hybrid mattress
definition: a mattress with a spring core under substantial foam or latex comfort layers.

name: Latex mattress
definition: a mattress whose core is natural or synthetic latex.

name: Airbed
definition: a mattress whose support is an inflatable air chamber, sold as a bed for a room.

name: Floor or futon mattress [shiki-futon]
definition: a thin mattress that folds or rolls away, used on the floor or on a futon sofa frame.

name: Slatted bed base
definition: a frame of sprung or flat slats that supports a mattress.

name: Divan base
definition: an upholstered box base on which a mattress sits, often with drawers.

name: Dining table
definition: a table made for eating meals at, seated.

name: Gateleg table
definition: a table with hinged leaves held up by legs that swing out like gates.

name: Coffee table
definition: a low table set in front of a sofa.

name: Side table
definition: a small table set beside a seat or bed (accent or end table).

name: Console table
definition: a narrow table set against a wall.

name: Tray table
definition: a small low table whose top is a tray, often removable or folding.

name: Desk
definition: a table made to work, write or study at, often with drawers.

name: Sit-stand desk
definition: a desk whose height adjusts between sitting and standing (drive is an attribute).

name: Dressing table
definition: a table with drawers and often a mirror, made to sit at while dressing or grooming.

name: Lap desk
definition: a small portable surface made to rest on the lap.

name: Folding table
definition: a table whose legs or top fold for storage or carrying.

name: Heated low table [kotatsu]
definition: a low floor table with a built-in heater beneath, covered by a quilt.

name: Rolling cart
definition: a small wheeled unit of shelves or baskets.

name: Kitchen island
definition: a freestanding or fitted work-surface unit standing clear of the kitchen walls.

name: Bar cart
definition: a wheeled cart made to hold and serve drinks.

name: Chest of drawers (dresser)
definition: a case of stacked drawers for clothes or linen.

name: Nightstand
definition: a small bedside cabinet or table with a drawer or shelf.

name: Sideboard
definition: a long low cabinet with doors and drawers for dining-room storage (buffet, credenza).

name: Display cabinet
definition: a cabinet with glass doors or sides for showing what it holds.

name: TV unit
definition: a low cabinet made to hold a television and media equipment.

name: Filing cabinet
definition: a cabinet of deep drawers for hanging files and papers.

name: Locker
definition: a tall narrow lockable cupboard, often in banks, for personal storage.

name: Kitchen cabinet
definition: a base, wall or tall cupboard made for kitchen storage, fitted or freestanding.

name: Bathroom vanity cabinet
definition: a bathroom cabinet made to carry a basin, sold without the basin.

name: Humidor (standing)
definition: a cabinet that stands in a room and keeps cigars at a set humidity.

name: Wardrobe (armoire)
definition: a tall cupboard with a hanging rail for clothes, freestanding or built in.

name: Bookcase
definition: a freestanding unit of open shelves.

name: Wall shelf
definition: a shelf made only to be fixed to a wall.

name: Modular shelving system
definition: a system of uprights, shelves and units that combine and extend within one maker's system.

name: Blanket chest (hope chest)
definition: a lidded box chest for linen and blankets.

name: Trunk
definition: a large strong lidded chest, kept as storage.

name: Storage box
definition: a lidded or open box or bin made to hold several objects in a home.

name: Storage basket
definition: a woven or wire basket made to hold several objects.

name: Shoe bag
definition: a hanging or zipped bag with pockets made to store shoes.

name: Wine rack
definition: a free-standing or wall rack that holds wine bottles lying down.

name: Shoe rack
definition: an open rack of tiers that holds pairs of shoes.

name: Magazine rack
definition: a rack or holder for magazines and newspapers.

name: Wall hook
definition: a hook or row of hooks fixed to a wall or door for hanging things.

name: Coat rack
definition: a free-standing stand or wall rail of hooks for coats and hats.

name: Clothes hanger
definition: a shaped frame from which a garment hangs on a rail.

name: Photo album (empty)
definition: a bound or binder album made to hold photographic prints, sold empty (page mechanism is an attribute).

name: Film album
definition: an album of sleeves made to hold negatives and slides.

name: Stamp album
definition: an album with printed or blank pages made to hold postage stamps.

name: Stock book
definition: a book of strip pockets in which stamps are slotted and held loose.

name: Coin album
definition: an album or folder of pages with holes or pockets made to hold coins.

name: Card binder
definition: a binder of pocket pages made to hold trading cards and similar cards.

name: Collection tray
definition: a tray of compartments made to hold coins, stamps or specimens.

name: Room divider
definition: a freestanding partition or open shelving unit that divides a room.

name: Folding screen
definition: a freestanding screen of hinged panels that folds.

name: Display stand
definition: a stand made to show objects or goods.

name: Plant stand
definition: a stand that raises one or more plant pots.

name: Shop counter and fitting
definition: a counter, gondola or shelving fitting made for a shop.

name: Pop-up gazebo
definition: a portable frame-and-canopy shelter that opens and folds without being built.

name: Bed slats
definition: loose slats made for one bed frame.

name: Bed guard rail
definition: a rail made to be fitted to one bed to keep a child from rolling out.

name: Table leg
definition: a leg sold to be fitted to a table top.

name: Replacement shelf
definition: a shelf made for one shelving or cabinet model.
